title: Tuesday Night Meditation and Dharma Teaching                                                      (We have moved to NEST RALEIGH)
location_address: 414 Fayetteville St Ave, Raleigh 4th floor (email or text for door code)
description:
We meet every Tuesday evening at NEST CO-WORKING SPACE,
414 Fayetteville Street - 4th floor.  For the door code send an email to info@sitraleigh.com or text me at 919-306-9495. (if you already have the code it stays the same)

For our teaching on Tuesday 11/24 Thankfulness and Gratitude will be our topic. When we see the interconnected nature of all beings, that even when we are face with the most difficult situations we most often get what we need (this doesn't mean we get what we want - that is a completely different story). When we cultivate an attitude of I get to versus I have to something wonderful happens. Join us in person or on Zoom.

We begin with a 25-30 minute meditation and finish with the Dharma talk. All are welcome. Class by Dana (generosity). 
Parking is free after 6pm on the street (in legal spaces) in downtown Raleigh. We are also on ZOOM if you cannot make it in person. (To join just click the register link button and you will join the meeting)
